description: Create meal plan. Required: from_date (ISO), meal_type_id (from list_meal_types), servings, and recipe_id or title. Optional: to_date (default from_date), note, addshopping (adds the recipe ingredients to the shopping list; needs recipe_id; skips ignored and, by default, on-hand foods).

addshopping.description: Add the recipe's ingredients to the shopping list.

from_date.description: Start date, YYYY-MM-DD or ISO datetime.

recipe_id.description: Recipe ID, from search_recipes. Needed when title is omitted.

title.description: Plan title. Needed when recipe_id is omitted.

to_date.description: End date, YYYY-MM-DD or ISO datetime. Defaults to from_date.

name: create_meal_plan
title: Create meal plan
